water_window_method: Native median9 RGB threshold (native_water_rule override, otherwise R>215 G>235 B>195 G-R>=8); source-water windows plus conservative native water interior polygons, applied after majority, never global pale exclusion
water_evidence: Native cyan lake cluster at source pixels x2100–2350 y2220–2370, distinct from beige aQIV surrounds. Cyan RGB rule only in this tight source lake window, plus a conservative central lake core. Small channels/shorelines remain approximate; no global pale/blue removal.

method: Actual legend-swatch Lab segmentation, not SAM. Text/hatch filtering and majority smoothing; no removed-small-region holes or nearest-neighbor geological infill. Corrected Kazakhstan border including Baikonur is unchanged.
